prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Copywriter
Hey there, One of our core service offerings for our eCommerce clients to drive more customers, sales and profits is great copy. We are looking for 2 copywriters who are curious and excited to leverage Artificial Intelligence for copywriting at scale to join our team. Your core responsibility is to generate rough-draft copy for blog posts, email campaigns, promotional campaigns and social media content using ChatGPT. FOR IMMEDIATE CONSIDERATION: Use one of our clients http://TheGutInstitute.Com to provide an example of AI generated copy for a blog post, email campaign for that blog post!
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Keep it under 150 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and excited to apply for this copywriting role. With 6 years of experience in Python, NLP, machine learning, and AI tools like OpenAI API and LangChain, I’m comfortable using ChatGPT to create rough-draft copy at scale for blog posts, email campaigns, promotional content, and social media.

I can quickly adapt to different brand voices and produce clear, engaging copy that is easy to refine and publish. I also understand how to use AI thoughtfully so the output stays useful, consistent, and aligned with business goals.

I’d be glad to create an AI-generated blog post and a matching email campaign sample for TheGutInstitute.com as part of my application. I’m ready to contribute immediately and help your team produce high-quality copy efficiently.
